rationale: The Court is likely to reverse on Egbert/Abbasi grounds: excessive force is a new Bivens context and the PLRA/BOP ARP constitute alternative remedial structures even if allegedly obstructed in this case. Expect a principal dissent (likely Sotomayor, possibly joined by Jackson) emphasizing that officer sabotage makes the alternative remedy illusory and that Carlson’s Eighth Amendment logic should control.
